hero.tagline: An impressionist journey through light, philosophy & the cosmos

moon.label: I. The Moon
moon.heading: Selene's silver chariot
moon.intro: Selene, the Greek Titaness of the Moon, drove her silver chariot across the night sky, illuminating the world with borrowed light — a reminder that even reflection can be a form of brilliance.

philosophy.label: II. The Waves
philosophy.heading: Ego, arrogance & the ocean of self
philosophy.intro: The wave does not know it is the ocean. It rises, believes itself unique, crashes against the shore, and dissolves — only to rise again. This is the cycle of ego: the endless assertion of separateness against the vast indifference of the sea.

gita.label: III. The Battlefield
gita.heading: Wisdom from the Bhagavad Gita
gita.intro: On the battlefield of Kurukshetra, between two armies of cousins, a conversation took place that would echo through millennia. Arjuna, paralyzed by doubt, and Krishna, the charioteer who was also God — their dialogue is not about war. It is about the war within.

shiva.label: IV. The Dance
shiva.heading: Shiva & the cosmic rhythm
shiva.intro: Before there was creation, there was Shiva — not as a being, but as a possibility. The Shiv Purana does not begin with "In the beginning" but with "In the endless." Shiva is the stillness that contains all motion, the silence that holds all music.

art.label: V. The Canvas
art.heading: Art, beauty & the act of seeing
art.intro: Art is not what you see, but what you make others see. The painter does not copy the world — they translate it, filtering reality through the lens of emotion, memory, and dream. Every brushstroke is a meditation, every color a prayer.
